item.title: Ahead of football title game, IU moves to protect a fountain after years of fishy antics
item.description: Indiana University has taken steps to protect Showalter Fountain and its bronze fish sculptures, which have a history of drawing celebrants, protesters, vandals and thieves, as the football team prepares to play in a national championship game.

item.title: Kyler D’Augustino’s 28 points lead IU Indy to overtime victory
item.description: Kyler D'Augustino's 28 points helped IU Indianapolis defeat Robert Morris 96-93 in overtime, breaking a six-game slide for the Jaguars.

item.title: IU hosting National Championship events in Miami, Bloomington
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — The Indiana Hoosiers will take on the Miami Hurricanes in the College Football Playoff National Championship Monday, and Indiana University is hosting several events for fans and attendees in Miami, Florida, and Bloomington, Indiana, this weekend. item.title: Chicago Bears hail Indiana’s stadium authority legislation as major step
item.description: The Chicago Bears have called the Indiana legislation to establish the Northwest Indiana Stadium Authority a "significant milestone" in their discussions around a potential stadium development in Chicagoland's Northwest Indiana region.

item.title: Hoosiers on campus gear up for CFP National Championship game
item.description: Thousands of Indiana University fans on Thursday lined up to receive commemorative towels ahead of the Hoosiers' College Football Playoff National Championship game against the Miami Hurricanes. Fans hope IU makes history as the first Indiana university to win the CFP title.

item.title: Trump to attend Hoosiers vs. Hurricanes championship game in Miami
item.description: President Donald Trump will attend the College Football Playoff National Championship game between the Indiana Hoosiers and the Miami Hurricanes on Monday night in Miami.

item.title: High-speed chase on snow-covered U.S. 31 ends with arrest of Indianapolis woman
item.description: Amber McDowell, of Indianapolis, was hospitalized and then jailed after state troopers pursued her in a high-speed chase on a snow-covered U.S. 31. Police say she reached speeds of nearly 100 mph. She faces charges that include OWI. She faces a similar charge in Hendricks County from a 2020 case.

item.title: New I-69 to I-465 bridge to bring Friday ramp closures, traffic limits
item.description: The Indiana Department of Transportation has announced ramp and lane closures from Friday night to Sunday morning to shift traffic onto a new ramp and bridge, with the new bridge expected to open Saturday morning.

item.title: Arctic air to follow Friday snowfall | Jan. 15, 2026
item.description: Central Indiana is expecting up to an inch of snow before Friday ends, followed by a cold weekend through early next week with single-digit and subzero wind chills possible.
